title: Case Studies of Real AI Systems — Reconstruct the Decision Tradeoffs
key_insight: Map each major choice to a requirement or constraint. List alternatives and what would make another choice better.
body:
## Reconstruct the Decision Tradeoffs

A team chose retrieval instead of fine-tuning. The useful question is not which method won, but why it fit their update rate and evidence needs.

Map each major choice to a requirement or constraint. List alternatives and what would make another choice better.

Compare systems only when their workloads match. Architecture copied without its constraints becomes cargo culting.
common_mistakes: An architecture diagram proves business success.
A famous design should be copied regardless of workload.
A postmortem is complete after blaming one operator.
mini_exercise: Draw “Reconstruct the Decision Tradeoffs” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Real systems show how model choices interact with users, data, organizations, and operations.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Reconstruct the Decision Tradeoffs,” explain Case Studies of Real AI Systems without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.

build_task.title: Analyze one real AI system
build_task.context: Turn Case Studies of Real AI Systems into one small, inspectable artifact.
steps: Select a documented system or incident.
Write its user job, scale, and constraints.
Map three design choices to evidence.
Extract two lessons and the conditions where they apply.
build_task.expected_output: A versioned artifact with visible decisions, evidence, and failure handling.
build_task.hint: Keep the scope bounded and record why each decision was made.

# Complete one step at a time.
# Record evidence and limits as you go.
